tasks.label: copy-windows-runcopy
args: $src = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}\snowcoreBlog.App' 'bin\Debug\net9.0-windows10.0.19041.0\win10-x64'; $dst = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}\snowcoreBlog.App' 'bin\RunCopy\net9.0-windows10.0.19041.0\win10-x64'; if (Test-Path $dst) { Remove-Item $dst -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dst -Force | Out-Null; Copy-Item (Join-Path $src '*') -Destination $dst -Recurse -Force
